name: Rallis India Ltd
title: Rallis India Ltd - 500355 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue up 6% to ₹456 cr with EBITDA at ₹-1 cr (vs ₹-19 cr); management sees industry shifting to seller's market on 15–25% input cost inflation, pricing hikes announced, but Q4 B2C volume was pushed via placement and Benzilla/Clasto inventory liquidation.

utilisation.quote: Overall Annual capacity utilization has also improved in FY26 in comparison to FY25.

triggers.label: Input cost up 15–25%; price hikes announced
triggers.quote: So we have seen 15% to 25% is generally the range.

triggers.label: Inventory slightly elevated; raw-material stockpiling
triggers.quote: At quarter end our inventory levels remain slightly elevated in comparison to the same quarter of last year

triggers.label: Q4 B2C volume aided by placement
triggers.quote: we have not gone for any significant placement more than what is required in quarter 4

triggers.label: Seeds high double-digit growth FY27
triggers.quote: I expect a combination of price and volume growth and expecting to deliver high double-digit growth again this year.

triggers.label: Exports down 33% in Q4
triggers.quote: Exports topline de-grew by 33% to ₹ 77 cr from ₹ 114 cr

guidance.quote: expecting to deliver high double-digit growth again this year.
It will be 5%, 8%, 10%. I don't know at this point of time
margins are expected to remain stable -to-soft.

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT loss; B2C gross margin softer on trouble products
red_flags.quote: On crop protection, stand-alone basis it was marginally down because, you know B2C business because of Benzilla and Clasto.

red_flags.label: Export revenue down 33% YoY
red_flags.quote: Exports topline de-grew by 33% to ₹ 77 cr from ₹ 114 cr

evasions.quote: So it's too difficult to say. From our perspective, we are trying to secure as much as possible supply for Kharif.
I don't have company-by-company detail. I don't have insight into other companies.
